title: Crab eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- legs -->
  <g stroke='#ff7043' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <path d='M30 70 L18 78'/>
    <path d='M28 62 L14 64'/>
    <path d='M30 54 L16 52'/>
    <path d='M70 70 L82 78'/>
    <path d='M72 62 L86 64'/>
    <path d='M70 54 L84 52'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='24' ry='17' fill='#ff5252'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='20' ry='12' fill='#ff8a65'/>
  <!-- shell pattern -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#ffb74d' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- eyes popped -->
  <line x1='42' y1='52' x2='42' y2='42' stroke='#ff8a65' stroke-width='3'/>
  <line x1='58' y1='52' x2='58' y2='42' stroke='#ff8a65' stroke-width='3'/>

  <path d='M30 58 Q20 48 24 40 Q28 34 34 40 Q38 46 32 54' fill='#ff5252' stroke='#ff7043' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#ffd54f'/>
  <polygon points='59,50 68,44 68,56' fill='#ffd54f'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#bf360c'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M44 62 Q50 68 56 62' stroke='#bf360c' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='60' r='3' fill='#ffab91' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='60' r='3' fill='#ffab91' opacity='0.8'/>
